title: Four rabbis attempt celestial ascent

tellings.quote: This is reflected in the Jewish parable of the parties, where four rabbis attempted celestial ascent and only one came back alive with his sanity intact.

plain: There is a Jewish parable, Michels says, in which four rabbis tried to rise up into the heavens and only one came back alive with his mind intact. He calls it the parable of the "parties", likely the orchard story known as Pardes, and he tells it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the idea that we live in a hologram. He uses it to suggest that reaching for what lies beyond ordinary reality can break the people who try.
